deploy-bot: Starting multi-service fanout deploy to production
deploy-bot: Commit tags: runtime@v2.14.0, api@v3.8.1, console@v1.9.7
deploy-bot: Change window: 03/20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (automated).

olivia.k: quick FYI — this includes the KV cache tweak we tested in staging? (runtime)
jamal: yes, runtime has the cache change. api/console are UI + routing only.

deploy-bot: Canary step: runtime -> promoted to 50% ✅
deploy-bot: Canary step: api -> promoted to 50% ✅

sophia: seeing a small spike in 5xxs for console in the canary group, watching.

deploy-bot: Canary step: console -> 10% deployed
ryan: console canary logs attached (snippet):
```
ERROR: UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning: TypeError at renderDashboard (/app/ui/render.js:82)
stack: TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined
```

jamal: that stack looks like a missing feature flag payload. console is reading `features.betaWidgets`.

infra-bot: Health check trend for console canary: 1m error rate 4.8% -> 12.3% over last 6m. Latency +120ms.

olivia.k: let's pause the console rollout. Do NOT promote to 50% yet. Runtime + API are green.

deploy-bot: Action: pause console rollout. Console remains at 10% canary. Runtime=rolled, API=rolled. (user: @olivia.k)

sophia: agree. Recommend pinning console back to v1.9.6 for prod traffic and continue runtime/api. Thoughts on partial rollback vs full rollback?

jamal: partial rollback for console only makes sense. We can pin console to v1.9.6 and route canary traffic away. That avoids touching runtime/api which are stable.

ryan: I can push a quick pin and re-route traffic to previous console. Will do emergency patch PR for the feature-flag null guard in parallel.

deploy-bot: Initiating partial rollback for console -> pin to console@v1.9.6 (initiated by ryan). Estimated completion ~2m.

deploy-bot: console rollback job started: job-id=rb-console-2000. Running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console --to-revision=12` on prod-cluster.

infra-bot: Rollback watch: console pods replacing (3/3 terminating -> 3/3 running). Ready replicas: 0 -> 3.

deploy-bot: console rollback completed ✅. console pinned to v1.9.6.

sophia: monitoring... latency back to baseline, errors dropping to ~0.6%.

olivia.k: great. leave console canary off for now until fix is in. Promote runtime + api to 100% if not already.

deploy-bot: Promoting runtime to 100% ✅. Promoting api to 100% ✅. Console remains pinned at v1.9.6 and canary traffic disabled.

jamal: opened PR #2789 with a defensive null check for `features.betaWidgets` and unit tests. Marking as hotfix candidate.

ryan: coordinating a small patch release for console@v1.9.8 once PR passes CI. Will target a mid-window quick deploy.

olivia.k: Thanks team. Postmortem notes: console rollout paused due to unguarded assumptions in feature payloads. Add checklist item for feature-flag schema validation in release notes.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary: runtime@v2.14.0 -> success, api@v3.8.1 -> success, console -> rollback to v1.9.6 (failed canary), change window still open until 03:00 UTC. Tickets: #RB-2000, PR-2789.

sophia: tagging oncall for follow-up: @jamal @ryan :eyes:

jamal: I'll run the staging validation for console fix and schedule a canary after we have green tests.

olivia.k: closing loop — no rollback for runtime/api. console hotfix/roll-forward plan in progress. :thumbsup:
